infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CivicLens records your voice so it can be turned into text, in the language you speak, for your complaint. Nothing is recorded until you press the microphone button.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CivicLens uses the camera to photograph the problem (for example a pothole) as evidence for your complaint.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CivicLens lets you attach an existing photo as evidence for your complaint.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CivicLens uses your location, only when you ask it to, to attach the place of the problem to your complaint.
